title: The Stale Pid File
story: The worker refuses to start: it says it is already running. But nothing is running.
goal: Prove the process is gone, remove the stale pid file and start the worker.

files./var/log/worker.log: worker already running (pid 5150), refusing to start

needs.msg: worker already running (pid 5150), refusing to start

tests.label: Checked that pid 5150 is not running

hints: Is there a process with pid 5150? ps will tell you.
Delete the pid file with rm, then systemctl start worker.

Run:
cat /var/run/worker.pid
ps
rm /var/run/worker.pid
systemctl start worker
socratic: Which command shows you the evidence you need?
explain: In one sentence: what was the cause, and how did you fix it?
